# Standard Operating Procedure - Generated by IBM Bob from BRD

## Agents:
1. Intake Agent: receives WhatsApp webhook, transcribes Kannada, extracts GPS
   - Inputs: image, audio, text, location
   - Outputs: normalized report JSON {id, type, lat, lon, lang, transcript}
   - Tools: transcribe_kannada, extract_gps

2. Verification Agent: Granite Vision verification
   - Tool: verify_civic_issue(image_url, description) -> {is_valid, type, severity, duplicate_id, confidence}
   - Policy: if confidence <0.7 -> human review

3. Routing Agent: Maps lat/lon to ward
   - KB: bbmp_wards.json, responsibility_matrix.csv
   - Tool: map_to_ward(lat,lon) -> {ward_id, je_name, je_phone, dept}
   - Generates ticket in Cloudant

4. Action Tracking Agent: SLA monitor
   - Tool: sla_tracker(ticket_id) checks timers, escalates
   - States: Open->InProgress->Resolved->Closed, Reopened on citizen feedback

5. Citizen Engagement Agent: Notifications
   - Tool: send_whatsapp_update(ticket_id, lang) + safety nudge templates
   - Approval required for safety messages via human template

## Workflow in watsonx Orchestrate:
Intake -> Verification -> Routing -> Tracking -> Engagement -> (loop back on feedback)

## Governance:
All agents auto-register via watsonx.governance API (Bob extension), audit logging, PII policy.

## Deployment: IBM Cloud - Cloudant, watsonx.data
